name: Perry Lane Hotel Savannah
positioning: Perry Lane Hotel, a Luxury Collection Hotel, in downtown Savannah, with eclectic Georgia-inspired design, local artwork and a rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want to explore Savannah's historic squares and parks by bicycle
Guests who enjoy local art and design
Travelers who want a rooftop pool and cocktails with city views

facts.text: The hotel is at 256 East Perry Street in downtown Savannah, Georgia.
The hotel is surrounded by live oak trees draped in Spanish moss and antebellum architecture.
The hotel's eclectic design pays homage to its Georgia roots with a curated collection of local artwork.
The residentially inspired guest rooms have oversized windows, Frette Italian bed linens and notable artwork.
Rooms come with plush bathrobes, soft slippers and marble bathrooms.
The Celebration Suite has full-length mirrors and individual vanities for getting ready in style.
The pool is open year round.
Private cabanas are available at the rooftop pool.
The Emporium Kitchen & Wine Market is the hotel's restaurant and wine market, open for breakfast, lunch and dinner.
Otium Studio holds regular yoga classes on the hotel's rooftop, which can also be booked for private groups.
Guests can take one of the hotel's bicycles down Savannah's cobblestone streets to places such as Forsyth Park, the Jepson Center for the Arts and Chippewa Square.
The rooftop deck has games such as bocce ball and bean bags for all ages.

highlights.text: The rooftop pool deck has views over the city.
Peregrin, on the hotel's rooftop, pairs panoramic views of Savannah with inventive cocktails and globally inspired small plates.
The hotel has a cozy library stocked through local booksellers, and guests can sign out books during their stay.
An arcade with games from pinball to skee-ball sits next to The Wayward bar.
In-room spa services such as massages and facials can be arranged.

considerations.text: Guest rooms do not have a fridge or a coffee or tea maker.
The minimum age to check in is 21.
Parking at the hotel is by on-site valet.
